text: Working on the relativedelta float-addition bug (dateutil/relativedelta.py). ETA ~10 min.

It raises `ValueError("Malformed timezone string.")`. In `tzres.name_from_string` (dateutil/tz/win.py, lines 104-111), any string starting with '@' is split on `',-'` and the second element is passed to `int()`; the bare `except:` around that conversion (catching both IndexError when the split has no second part and ValueError when the text isn't an integer) re-raises a `ValueError` with that message.

It returns the `default` argument (which defaults to `None`), i.e. `None` if no default was supplied. `ZoneInfoFile.get` is just a thin wrapper: `return self.zones.get(name, default)` (dateutil/zoneinfo/__init__.py, lines 74-88).
On it: fixing the rrule count=0 bug (dateutil/rrule.py). ETA ~12 min.

It returns `None`. `tzwinbase.transitions(year)` starts with `if not self.hasdst: return None` (dateutil/tz/win.py, lines 151-167); for zones with an annual DST transition it returns the `(dston, dstoff)` tuple of datetimes instead.
Still in progress: the relativedelta float-addition fix (dateutil/relativedelta.py) is being implemented and verified. ETA ~6 min.
Still in progress: the rrule count=0 fix (dateutil/rrule.py) is being implemented and verified. ETA ~10 min.

It verifies the integrity of the downloaded tzdata tarball: `assert metadata['tzdata_file_sha512'] == sha_512_file, "SHA failed for"` (updatezinfo.py line 47). `sha_512_file` is the SHA-512 hexdigest of the file named by `metadata['tzdata_file']` that was just downloaded, and it is compared against the expected digest recorded in `zonefile_metadata.json`; if they differ, the assertion fails.
On it: fixing the rrule `__str__`/RRULE token bug (dateutil/rrule.py). ETA ~12 min.

It logs an error message via `logging.error(...)`: "Could not find zic. Perhaps you need to install libc-bin or some other package that provides it, or it's not in your PATH?" (dateutil/zoneinfo/rebuild.py lines 41-51). It returns `None` (the caller then re-raises the exception). For any other errno it does nothing.
It raises `ValueError("invalid method")`. `easter()` starts with `if not (1 <= method <= 3): raise ValueError("invalid method")` (dateutil/easter.py lines 52-53), so 0 is rejected.
On it: fixing the parser `fuzzy_with_tokens` bug (dateutil/parser.py). ETA ~12 min.
`EASTER_WESTERN` (i.e. 3): `def easter(year, method=EASTER_WESTERN)` in dateutil/easter.py line 16.
Still in progress (relativedelta float addition). ETA ~4 min.
The rrule count=0 fix is implemented and verified (rrule test suite: 542 passed; full suite: 1064 passed, 43 skipped, no regressions). Final check running; ETA ~2 min.
Still in progress (rrule __str__ / RRULE token). ETA ~6 min.
Still in progress (parser fuzzy_with_tokens). ETA ~8 min.

It writes it into the generated zoneinfo tarball as the metadata file: after `zic` has built the zone directory, `rebuild` does `with open(os.path.join(zonedir, METADATA_FN), 'w') as f: json.dump(metadata, f, indent=4, sort_keys=True)` (dateutil/zoneinfo/rebuild.py lines 30-32), and that `METADATA_FN` file is then added to the tarball along with the compiled zones. If `metadata` is None, `json.dump` writes `null`.
On it: fixing the parser `_idx`/token-index bug (dateutil/parser.py). ETA ~12 min.

It returns `None`. `tzrangebase.utcoffset` (dateutil/tz/_common.py lines 244-252) does `isdst = self._isdst(dt)` and then `if isdst is None: return None`; otherwise it returns `self._dst_offset` (when DST) or `self._std_offset`. (`_isdst` returns None when `dt is None`, i.e. for a naive `utcoffset(None)` call.)

It re-raises the last `URLError` from the failed mirror attempts: `last_error` is set to each `urllib_error.URLError` caught in the loop, and after the loop `if last_error is not None: raise last_error` (updatezinfo.py lines 26-41).
On it: fixing the relativedelta absolute-addition bug (dateutil/relativedelta.py). ETA ~10 min.

It warns and returns `None`: `getzoneinfofile_stream()` wraps `BytesIO(get_data(__name__, ZONEFILENAME))` in `try/except IOError`, and on IOError it calls `warnings.warn("I/O error({0}): {1}".format(e.errno, e.strerror))` and returns `None` (dateutil/zoneinfo/__init__.py lines 34-39).
Still in progress (relativedelta float addition). ETA ~5 min.

Fixed and verified: rrule count=0 now yields zero occurrences (count=None stays infinite, count=N yields exactly N). dateutil/test/test_rrule.py: 542 passed; full suite: 1064 passed, 43 skipped, no regressions.
Still in progress (rrule __str__ / RRULE token). ETA ~4 min.
Still in progress (parser fuzzy_with_tokens). ETA ~6 min.
Still in progress (parser _idx/token index). ETA ~7 min.
Still in progress (relativedelta absolute addition). ETA ~8 min.

It raises `TypeError("fromutc() requires a datetime argument")` (dateutil/tz/_common.py, `_tzinfo._fromutc`, lines 170-171). It also raises `ValueError("dt.tzinfo is not self")` if the tzinfo doesn't match, and `ValueError` for a None `utcoffset()`/`dst()` result.
